excerpt: ## Exact TRAIN exam and learning
- Complete: 300 states / 60 worlds / all 12 demand×share cells; 4,500 labels
at 120/300/600 s, and 240 O2/O3 joint/solo-credit rows. No dev data used for fitting.
- High-demand .2/.4 cells have 180 states; 20 satisfy the prospective dense rule.
- Helpful available option in 45/300 states = 15%, world-bootstrap 95% CI [10%,20.33%].
Only 81 states have an eligible two-CAV group. The mixture is intentionally oversampled.
- Oracle saving 588.48 veh-s/state, CI [295.05,961.64]. Registered nested-CV saving 0;
regret 588.48 with the same CI; 0 selected options. Full-fit uncertainty radius 9612.20.
- Confidence uses nested world-grouped signed overprediction, a 95% quantile of
each world's worst error across options/times; choose positive lower bound or O0.
This is CV-derived uncertainty, not a behavioural threshold or live guarantee.
- Available/helpful: O1 metering 81/30, O2 wall 34/9, O3 ramp gap 43/14, O4 gap 81/31.
Mean available-option effects are harmful: -1176/-1153/-1736/-1022 veh-s.
Best observed effects: +14992/+9917/+6338/+17154 veh-s; selected TRAIN maxima.
- Primary model importance emphasizes second-member rear gap/position/speed;
O3 also emphasizes first-member position and receiving-lane speed. PDP plots
describe model associations; no reliably beneficial observable rule was learned.
## MAIN02:21 H300 continuation — COMPLETE, separate confirmation and wall panels
Prospective design/source03256981; all three frozen hosts30CPU/0skips plus actual WMDECIDE H300 parity PASS before one-shot dispatch.
Fresh never-fit confirmation18DEV983300–983317: TWO worlds per .4/.2/.1 x2700/2400/1900 cell, high-share first; separate wall6DEV983318–983323: .2/.4 x2400/2700, extra repeats in .4cells.
ALL new predictions and ALL-executed-group twins useH300; cadence60/same inherited grid/safety/noise/strict0.8 gate. Completed H120 panels above are preserved.
Prospective234720continuation=57600paired +177120adaptive lookaheads/complete solos;9780/world,78240per host, global upper799860/800000,140unallocated.
Fixed per-world quotas protect every full pair and both solos before prediction; cyclic pruning/MAPPO fallback expected. Availability of O2 is logged before budget admission at every decision.
Corrected HOLD COOPFREE learned checkpoint absent at shared freeze (legacy weights excluded); no outcome-dependent late switch.
New immutable `_v3` supervisors cpuQ693091/gpuA348726/gpuR768580 all COMPLETE, no STOP/incomplete attempts/outstanding reservations; no replay/relaunch/refund.
H120-versus-H300 summaries compare different fresh panels and different budget availability, not a paired causal horizon effect. Full-rerun predictions remain synchronous offline.
### Paired H300 delay and ALL-group cooperation credit
Same score units and10000 whole-world bootstrap RNG20261101; all executed groups have both member-alone twins, no sign exclusions.
Ten group actions (O1=2/O2=1/O3=3/O4=4);5/10 positive C_G in9/18active worlds.
Event-weighted mean C_G **-100.774 [-1071.707,785.406] veh-s/action**.
Four group actions (O1=3/O2=1);0/4 positive C_G in4/6active worlds.
Mean C_G **-681.287 [-1295.768,-144.359]**;12/10000 zero-action resamples undefined/excluded and disclosed.
Both panels support J600 benefit, not a robust J900 benefit or positive mean superadditivity. The wall-panel credit interval is negative but based on only four actions/six worlds.
### Why O2 did not emerge atH120, and what H300 actually shows

Under the original nearest-two upstream/adjacent-lane eligibility rule, H120 O2 was available/evaluated37/432decisions, helpful versus MAPPO in3, but outscored by another option in all3; chosen0. Mean evaluated D_O2-950.761, range[-2269.631,+243.858]. This was not an unavailable/disabled option.
- **H300 confirmation18:** O2 available22/216decisions, evaluated9, budget-skipped13, helpful2, chosen1 (one helpful wall outscored). Mean evaluated D_O2-1170.145.
- **H300 wall6:** O2 available17/72, evaluated6, budget-skipped11, helpful1, chosen1. Mean evaluated D_O2-925.232.

Eligibility is logged BEFORE pruning at every registered decision; the24 H300 budget-skipped wall opportunities are untested, not rejected by the predictor. Overall quota pruning affected31confirmation and32wall-panel decisions, including partial candidate pruning.
**Executed confirmation wall983303/t360:** members mainline.171/mainline.167, O2/L3 magnitude3,60s; exactH300 **D_G+13.851684**, solos**-205.778376/+38.059435**, **C_G+181.570625**.

**Executed wall-test wall983321/t480:** members mainline.208/mainline.209, magnitude6,60s; **D_G+2442.101011**, solos**+2510.676566/+360.283172**, **C_G-428.858726**. A helpful joint wall need not be superadditive; its strongest solo helps more.
Thus the H300 planner demonstrably executes a superadditive wall and a large-benefit wall; these separate-world results do not prove that a longer horizon alone caused either difference.

analysis.unit: world cluster (all branches of a world resampled together)

arm_execution.MAPPO: derived from the per-world MAPPO reference episode (0 new sim-s if reused)

branches.rule: fixed evenly spaced grid in [warmup, end-horizon], identical for every world, fixed before any outcome; no state/outcome-dependent selection

budget.formula: sum_arms!=MAPPO worlds*sum_T(T+H) + [worlds*(maxT+H) if MAPPO reference not reused]
budget.saved_state_note: NOT this design: restoring a saved SUMO state is physically exact but not a bitwise rerun (S-ENSPROBE insertion-cache/CF-LC memory residual); would need a separate amendment

budget_with_later_arms.formula: sum_arms!=MAPPO worlds*sum_T(T+H) + [worlds*(maxT+H) if MAPPO reference not reused]
budget_with_later_arms.saved_state_note: NOT this design: restoring a saved SUMO state is physically exact but not a bitwise rerun (S-ENSPROBE insertion-cache/CF-LC memory residual); would need a separate amendment

metric.definition: J_b = team_delay_vs(T+H) - team_delay_vs(T); road speed deficit + source waiting, veh-s
metric.name: paired 300 s team delay
metric.percent_reduction: 100*(sum J_comp - sum J_treat)/sum J_comp over the resampled worlds (positive = improvement)

branches.note: MAIN23:15/23:54: native episode-only; R branches deferred; fixed A/B48

prefix.fairness: the prefix policy is the comparator itself and is independent of A/B/R; every arm faces the identical physical state, MAPPO executor memory and roster at T; A/B/R are residuals on MAPPO, so MAPPO-induced states are on their support; MAPPO is not favoured by state selection because times are fixed a priori
prefix.mechanism: every arm reruns SUMO from t=0 under the SAME code path; before T its residual requests are suppressed (exact zero abstains -> MAPPO commands); fingerprints for every second 300..T must equal the MAPPO reference episode bit-for-bit, else STOP (no retry)

rng.policy_noise_seed: sha256(world,T,arm)[:15] recorded; deterministic arms draw no physical noise

checks: TRAIN every4/dev every16, reporting only; final A/B48,R24
discovery: 200000sim-s; complete n+2 prefixes reserved before exact twins; no partial group

focus.evidence_limit: existing opportunity/oracle evidence motivates owner hypothesis; no established stratum treatment effect
